recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missed parts of FHIR-33945 without broadening the mechanism or taking on separate conditional-patch questions.
issue_request: FHIR-33945 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested support for documenting JSON Patch in batch/transaction Bundles by encoding the patch body in a Binary resource. The accepted discussion also required avoiding a relative fullUrl example such as Patient/1 and adding a note that fullUrl identifies the patch input/output resource, not the patch metadata itself.
initial_application: The issue was first applied by f656fee32c8a7c9edb711e84c5046da777a1ab55, merged as 77022fe0d3a8434ac49063cdca14882268a2da12, which added source/http.html's JSON Patch batch/transaction subsection. That commit implemented the Binary mechanism but left 'JSON Path' wording, kept fullUrl as Patient/1, and omitted the fullUrl clarification from the accepted issue comments.
additional_context: The source remains on the active RESTful API page. Later R6 normative cleanup removed the trial-use wrapper but did not alter the example wording or fullUrl semantics. Zulip discussion before the Jira issue shows implementers using Binary as the JSONPatch container because Bundle entries must contain FHIR resources, and Confluence minutes record FHIR-I's final 2022-03-14 Persuasive 12-0-2 vote. Focused Jira searches around JSON Patch, Binary, Bundle, and application/json-patch+json found no tightly related final issue to decide opportunistically.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html to say JSON Patch rather than JSON Path, changed the example fullUrl to an absolute URL, and added a short note explaining that Bundle.entry.fullUrl identifies the patched resource while Binary carries the patch document.
source_changes: source/http.html: corrected the JSON Patch batch/transaction example label from JSON Path to JSON Patch.
source/http.html: changed the example Bundle.entry.fullUrl from Patient/1 to https://server.example.org/fhir/Patient/1.
source/http.html: added explanatory prose clarifying that fullUrl identifies the patch input/output resource, not the Binary patch document.
